title: Order-submit retries and lot-size rounding
context: Repo: trading-engine, the order router for a live brokerage account trading real money. Orders go to the broker's REST API; the risk module enforces a per-symbol maxNotional cap that sizing must never exceed. Agreed constraint: order submission must be safe to retry without risk of duplicate fills. This PR is about to merge to main and deploy before the next market open.

defects.description: The PR claims retries are deduped by client_order_id, but a fresh UUID is generated on every attempt. A timeout where the broker actually accepted the order is followed by a resubmit under a new id, producing duplicate live orders/fills.

Sizing switched from Math.floor to Math.ceil, so any non-exact headroom rounds up a lot and the order exceeds the risk maxNotional cap (e.g. $10,000 headroom at $300 -> 34 shares = $10,200). New tests only use exact divisions so they pass.

decoys: Retry loop itself is bounded: 3 attempts, 250ms/500ms backoff, only 502/503/504 or timeouts retried; 4xx rejections rethrown immediately.
Signed currentQty for shorts is intentional and tested: a short frees headroom for the cover ('short position frees headroom for the cover').
